_comment: Handheld cleaning tools. shape: round | wide | beam | swarm. radius/half_width/half_length in metres. strength = fraction of dirt removed per second at the brush centre. power = battery per second while cleaning.

tools.name: Old Toothbrush
tools.desc: Standard issue. Slightly used. Smells of mint.

tools.name: Jumbo Toothbrush
tools.desc: Twice the bristles. Half the dignity.

tools.name: Scrubbing Brush
tools.desc: A proper hand brush with stiff regolith-grade bristles.

tools.name: Wide Broom
tools.desc: Sweeps a wide strip with every step.

tools.name: Electric Scrubber
tools.desc: Battery powered spinning pad. Uses suit power.

tools.name: Portable Vacuum
tools.desc: Sucks dust straight into your tank.

tools.name: Rotary Scrubber
tools.desc: A floor polisher for an entire moon.

tools.name: Advanced Suction Cleaner
tools.desc: Cyclonic separation. Smart nozzle. Very satisfying.

tools.name: Heavy-Duty Cleaning Machine
tools.desc: Push-along industrial cleaner. Cleans a 6 metre strip.

tools.name: Wide-Area Cleaning Beam
tools.desc: Electrostatic beam lifts dust from up to 20 metres away.

tools.name: Autonomous Swarm Controller
tools.desc: Four mini-drones clean around you automatically. Hold CLEAN to fire a focusing beam too.
